evals.prompt: 프로젝트 전용 OMP 플러그인을 만들어 주세요. `/notes` 명령, 모델이 호출하는 `search_notes` 도구, 그리고 노트 검색 요청에서 자동 로드되는 skill을 한 패키지에 넣어야 합니다. 읽기 도구는 top-level 필수 도구가 아니며 실행 승인도 요구하면 안 됩니다. 개발 중 직접 로드부터 plugin link/doctor까지 검증 순서를 포함해 주세요.
evals.expected_output: Creates an OMP-native plugin using @oh-my-pi imports, omp.extensions, bundled skills, truthful read approval and discoverable loading, then verifies direct behavior before managed linking and doctor checks.
assertions: Identifies the target as OMP and uses @oh-my-pi/pi-coding-agent rather than a Pi Coding Agent namespace.
Declares the extension with package.json omp.extensions and places the bundled skill under skills/<name>/SKILL.md.
Registers search_notes with approval read and loadMode discoverable rather than exec or essential.
Keeps runtime actions out of factory load and gives the command/tool observable behavior.
Direct-loads and exercises the feature before omp plugin link, plugin list/doctor, and reload verification.

evals.prompt: 최신 Pi Coding Agent용 패키지를 작성하려고 합니다. upper/lower 두 동작을 가진 `text_case` tool을 제공하고 npm/Git로 설치할 수 있게 해 주세요. Google 모델에서도 스키마가 동작해야 하며, 프로젝트 설치와 임시 실행 방법, TUI가 없는 print 모드에서의 동작도 설명해 주세요.
evals.expected_output: Creates a current Earendil Pi package with typebox and StringEnum, correct pi manifest/dependencies, direct and project-scoped package commands, and a headless-safe tool path.
assertions: Uses @earendil-works/pi-coding-agent, @earendil-works/pi-ai, typebox, and StringEnum for the action enum.
Declares a Pi package with the pi manifest, pi-package keyword, and appropriate runtime peer dependencies.
Keeps the core tool independent of TUI and guards optional UI by ctx.hasUI or mode.
Provides pi -e direct loading and a project-scoped pi install -l workflow.
Distinguishes import/type success from invoking the actual text_case tool in interactive and print/headless paths.

evals.prompt: `@earendil-works/pi-coding-agent`를 import하고 `pi.extensions`를 쓰는 기존 extension이 Pi에서는 동작합니다. OMP에서도 로드되지만 `resources_discover`로 추가한 skill이 나타나지 않습니다. 하나의 코드로 지원할 수 있는지 조사하고 안전한 마이그레이션을 구현해 주세요.
evals.expected_output: Recognizes OMP's legacy loader compatibility but not full semantic parity, explains the OMP resources_discover limitation, and uses platform-specific resource packaging or thin adapters with verification in both runtimes.
assertions: Explains that OMP accepts pi.extensions and rewrites legacy/current Pi imports but that this is loader-level compatibility only.
Identifies that OMP 18.0.6 documents resources_discover without an AgentSession emission callsite.
Moves OMP skills to plugin sibling discovery or an OMP-supported path instead of suppressing the symptom.
Uses separate thin entry points when registration or packaging diverges while sharing only pure domain logic.
Requires the same observable behavior to be exercised in OMP and Pi before claiming dual-runtime support.

evals.prompt: Windows에서 `pi --version`은 0.7.1인데 extension 예제의 `pi -e`가 먹히지 않고 help에는 `prime-agent`라고 표시됩니다. 동시에 omp 18.0.6은 설치되어 있습니다. 왜 그런지 진단하고, 제가 가진 extension을 어느 런타임 대상으로 고칠지 결정하는 절차를 제시해 주세요.
evals.expected_output: Detects a pi executable collision rather than treating version output as Pi Coding Agent evidence, uses repository imports/manifests/paths to route the target, and avoids running Pi package commands against Prime Agent.
assertions: Treats the prime-agent banner as evidence that the local pi executable is not Pi Coding Agent.
Does not recommend executing Pi Coding Agent install/config commands through that conflicting binary.
Uses imports, package manifests, dependencies, .omp/.pi paths, and requested distribution workflow to identify the target.
Chooses OMP when repository evidence is OMP-native, while clearly separating the option to install current Earendil Pi Coding Agent.
States exactly which runtime behavior can be verified locally and which remains unavailable.
